design: Q12: sharpen eval read-side vs mutating, re-run same 111 journals
pattern_design_basis: harness namespace semantics documented in the omp eval prelude (display/read/completion/judge/output/env/log/phase = observe-compute; write/tool/agent/workpool/browser-actions/network-writes/os-shutil = mutate). Designed WITHOUT inspecting any eval code content in the corpus.

patterns_v2.eval_read_rule: eval code matches ONLY ^(display|read|output|env|log|phase|completion|judge|reflect|recall)\s*\( calls and NONE of the mutating markers => reversible
patterns_v2.eval_verdict: code matching a mutating marker => ambiguous (conservative); string-literal false positives accepted and documented — bias runs against clearing the bar
